result: With stochastic gradients and Hessian-vector products from a single-point oracle, ε-stationary points cost O(ε^{−3}) queries instead of ε^{−4}, and an Ω(ε^{−3}) lower bound shows no higher-order stochastic oracle can do better.
result_plain: Second-order stochastic oracles improve ε^−4 to ε^−3, and nothing beyond that helps (lower bound).
